reason: The plugin primarily orchestrates communication and coordination among live DeepSeek Harness Sessions in one runtime through discovery, inspection, messaging, steering, optional cancellation, and reply observation tools.

summaries.zh: 用于在同一 DeepSeek Harness 运行时中发现、检查并协调多个活动 Session，支持消息发送、方向调整及可选的取消与回复观察。
summaries.en: Coordinates live DeepSeek Harness Sessions within one runtime by providing discovery, inspection, messaging, steering, optional cancellation, and reply-observation tools.

capabilities: Lists and inspects live Sessions within the same DSH process
Queues follow-up work for another Session
Steers a Session at its next step boundary
Optionally cancels active root-Session work when enabled
Observes completion of a turn that claimed a sent message
